title: Tussey Mountain Outfitters
specs: Paddle on Spring Creek and Bald Eagle Creek with scenic rural settings and wildlife including Bald Eagles, Ospreys, Kingfishers, Blue Herons
Excellent trout fishing on both streams
Historic Curtin Village Ironworks picnic stop along the way
Minimum age 6; minors must be accompanied by someone over 21 responsible for them
Minimum age 14 and paddling skills required to paddle solo canoes, kayaks, or SUPs
Under 14 must paddle with an adult in two-person canoes or kayaks
Paddlers must be physically capable of handling watercraft and able to swim in swift current and self rescue

blurb: Tussey Mountain Outfitters offers canoe and kayak rentals and guided paddle trips on Spring Creek and Bald Eagle Creek. They provide all equipment including boats, paddles, life jackets, dry bags, and helmets, plus transport and driver shuttles for trips.
